Task 2 · 教育 小学课堂中的学习与游戏
0% · 0 / 2 完成

直接回应下面的完整题干。

待改写的立场句（自编）：I agree that play is useful because children enjoy it.

Some people argue that primary schools focus too much on formal learning. To what extent do you agree with this opinion? How important do you think it is for children to play as well as learn in the primary school classroom?

把上面的立场句改写为 35–50 个英文词，同时回答两个问题。立场须允许一部分正式教学保留。

作答 1
暂时不会

写 80–110 个英文词，论证课堂游戏的一项学习价值，并用一个具体课堂活动说明。结尾说明这个活动为什么仍需要教师设计或引导。

作答 2
暂时不会
答案
再练一次

Task 2 · 旅游 旅游收益与居民成本
0% · 0 / 2 完成

在给定情境下作答，不把假设写成真实统计。

本练习的假设情境：旅游给当地商店带来收入，但旺季过后部分岗位消失；短租扩张减少了居民可租住房。地方政府可以对短租登记并征收用于公共交通的游客税。

International tourism has brought enormous benefit to many places. At the same time, there is concern about its impact on local inhabitants and the environment. Do the disadvantages of international tourism outweigh the advantages?

写 40–55 个英文词的立场段。不能只写“有好处也有坏处”；比较时须涉及受益者、受损者或影响持续时间。

作答 1
暂时不会

写 80–110 个英文词，比较商店收入与居民住房成本。结尾直接回答哪一方更重要，以及这个判断依赖什么条件。

作答 2
暂时不会
答案
再练一次

Task 2 · 城市住房 高层住宅是否是最佳方案
0% · 0 / 2 完成

围绕原题中的“best way”作答。

待改写句（自编）：Tall buildings contain more homes, so they are the best solution everywhere and will make housing affordable.

The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

将上面的句子改写为 35–50 个英文词。保留高层住宅的一项优势，但不给出题干未能支持的必然结果。

作答 1
暂时不会

写 80–110 个英文词：在土地紧张的城市里，将高层建设与“改造现有空置建筑”比较。选择一个判断标准，形成有条件的明确立场。

作答 2
暂时不会
答案
再练一次

To what extent do you agree with this opinion? How important do you think it is for children to play as well as learn in the primary school classroom?把上面的立场句改写为 35–50 个英文词，同时回答两个问题。立场须允许一部分正式教学保留。作答 1暂时不会写 80–110 个英文词，论证课堂游戏的一项学习价值，并用一个具体课堂活动说明。结尾说明这个活动为什么仍需要教师设计或引导。作答 2暂时不会答案1. 示例：I partly agree that primary schools devote too much time to formal instruction. Although direct teaching remains necessary, well-designed classroom play is important because it allows children to apply knowledge and practise cooperation in a meaningful setting.2. 示例：Classroom play can make an abstract skill easier to use. For example, a teacher could organise a small shop in which pupils take turns buying items with pretend money. Children would have to add prices, calculate change and explain their choices to classmates. This activity gives a practical purpose to calculations that might otherwise remain a page of exercises. However, simply providing toys would not ensure that pupils learnt the intended skill. The teacher would still need to choose suitable prices, observe mistakes and help pupils understand how to correct them.再练一次仍回答原题，写 40–55 个英文词的结论。明确区分“正式教学过多”和“正式教学完全无用”，不要新增一个此前未论证的社会问题。作答暂时不会答案示例：Primary education should therefore place less emphasis on prolonged formal instruction, while preserving direct teaching where it is useful. Structured play deserves a regular place in the classroom because it helps children apply what they learn, but its educational value depends on thoughtful planning and guidance.选材来源 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · Test 4 · Task 2Task 2 · 旅游 旅游收益与居民成本0% · 0 / 2 完成在给定情境下作答，不把假设写成真实统计。本练习的假设情境：旅游给当地商店带来收入，但旺季过后部分岗位消失；短租扩张减少了居民可租住房。地方政府可以对短租登记并征收用于公共交通的游客税。International tourism has brought enormous benefit to many places. At the same time, there is concern about its impact on local inhabitants and the environment. Do the disadvantages of international tourism outweigh the advantages?写 40–55 个英文词的立场段。不能只写“有好处也有坏处”；比较时须涉及受益者、受损者或影响持续时间。作答 1暂时不会写 80–110 个英文词，比较商店收入与居民住房成本。结尾直接回答哪一方更重要，以及这个判断依赖什么条件。作答 2暂时不会答案1. 示例：In the situation described, the disadvantages outweigh the advantages if tourism income mainly reaches businesses while residents face lasting housing pressure. Temporary increases in trade cannot by themselves justify a continuing loss of affordable homes. Effective regulation could, however, change that balance.2. 示例：Tourism may increase sales in local shops, but this benefit does not necessarily reach residents who must pay higher rents. The jobs created may also disappear after the main holiday season, whereas the conversion of homes into short-term accommodation can affect housing throughout the year. In this case, I would give greater weight to the lasting pressure on residents than to a temporary rise in commercial income. The balance could become more favourable if registration limits the loss of residential housing and visitor taxes finance services used by local people.再练一次把情境改为：短租得到有效控制，游客税确实改善了居民交通。用 35–50 个英文词说明原结论如何调整；不得声称旅游已经没有环境成本。作答暂时不会答案示例：With effective controls on short-term rentals and visible improvements in local transport, the economic benefits would be more likely to outweigh the disadvantages. However, that judgement would still depend on whether visitor activity placed manageable pressure on the environment.选材来源 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · Task 2B · 在线来源Task 2 · 城市住房 高层住宅是否是最佳方案0% · 0 / 2 完成围绕原题中的“best way”作答。待改写句（自编）：Tall buildings contain more homes, so they are the best solution everywhere and will make housing affordable.The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?将上面的句子改写为 35–50 个英文词。保留高层住宅的一项优势，但不给出题干未能支持的必然结果。作答 1暂时不会写 80–110 个英文词：在土地紧张的城市里，将高层建设与“改造现有空置建筑”比较。选择一个判断标准，形成有条件的明确立场。作答 2暂时不会答案1. 示例：Tall apartment blocks can provide many homes on a limited area of land, making them useful in densely populated cities. However, additional supply does not automatically make housing affordable, and high-rise construction may not be the best option in every neighbourhood.2. 示例：Where suitable vacant buildings already exist, converting them into homes may provide accommodation sooner than constructing new towers. On a short-term delivery criterion, conversion could therefore be the better option, provided the buildings are safe and reasonably inexpensive to adapt. However, the supply of suitable vacant property is limited, and conversion cannot be assumed to meet all future demand. I would support high-rise development where land is scarce and existing buildings cannot supply enough homes, rather than treating it as the best response to every housing shortage.再练一次写 35–50 个英文词的结论。明确同意程度，并保留“新增住房数量”和“住房可负担性”的区别。作答暂时不会答案示例：I therefore agree that high-rise construction can be an important response to urban housing shortages, but not that it is always the best one. Cities should assess alternative sources of supply, while using separate measures to ensure that additional homes are affordable.选材来源 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · Test 1 · Task 2
